rows.title: Each screen, on the render pool and on its own container

panels.title: Problem (1 = something is wrong)
panels.description: By screen (its slug), whether the render pool draws it (the device attribute) or its own renderer container (the device attribute too, or else its host.name), so a screen reads the same either way. Own containers that report neither share one series, "own containers, screen not known". 1 when an API is in error, or (pool) the last render failed. countdown.problem.
expr: label_replace(label_move(max by (host.name, host_name) (last_over_time(countdown.problem{device=""}[5m])), "host.name", "device", "host_name", "device"), "device", "own containers, screen not known", "device", "")

panels.title: APIs in error
panels.description: By screen (its slug), whether the render pool draws it (the device attribute) or its own renderer container (the device attribute too, or else its host.name), so a screen reads the same either way. Own containers that report neither share one series, "own containers, screen not known". Each API whose status is error or fatal. countdown.api.status.
expr: label_replace(label_move(max by (host.name, host_name, api, status) (last_over_time(countdown.api.status{device="", status=~"error|fatal"}[5m])), "host.name", "device", "host_name", "device"), "device", "own containers, screen not known", "device", "")

panels.title: Stage
panels.description: By screen (its slug), whether the render pool draws it (the device attribute) or its own renderer container (the device attribute too, or else its host.name), so a screen reads the same either way. Own containers that report neither share one series, "own containers, screen not known". What the screen shows: pairing or running. countdown.stage.
expr: label_replace(label_move(max by (host.name, host_name, stage) (last_over_time(countdown.stage{device=""}[5m])), "host.name", "device", "host_name", "device"), "device", "own containers, screen not known", "device", "")

panels.title: Time since the last good frame, by screen
panels.description: Now minus countdown.render.last_success, the highest across workers. Climbs for a screen that's stuck while the rest of the pool carries on; a few minutes is too long.

panels.title: Failed renders per minute, by screen
Renders per minute, by outcome
panels.description: countdown.render.count for the whole pool: written (a new frame), unchanged (skipped: nothing changed) or failed.

panels.title: Render time, whole pool
panels.description: countdown.render.duration, p50 and p95 over every screen. A warm render takes about 50 ms; the deadline is 20 s.

panels.title: Queue wait
panels.description: countdown.render.lag, p50 and p95: how long jobs wait before a worker takes them. The minute's frames should land within 3 s of it.

panels.title: Jobs queued
panels.description: countdown.render.queued: jobs waiting for a worker. Persistently above zero means the pool needs another worker.

panels.title: Panels drawn "Not available", by screen
panels.description: countdown.render.expired_panels: panels whose key had expired at the screen's last render (its provider is behind or down). Empty while every panel has its data.
